'''DecipherCon 1999''' (DecipherCon '99) was Decipher's first company convention, held 11–14 November 1999 at the Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia. It hosted the [[1999 Decipher World Championship|Star Wars CCG World Championship]], in which [[Gary Carman]] defeated [[Steven Lewis]] 2 (+19).<ref name="dc99-home">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/ DecipherCon 1999], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020823212712/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/ Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sw">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/swworldchamp/index.html Star Wars CCG World Championship], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991128144348/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/swworldchamp/index.html Internet Archive]</ref> The same weekend hosted the Star Trek CCG World Championship, won by Mike Harrington, and the Young Jedi World Championship, won by Greg Heisler.<ref name="lal-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html DecipherCon '99 — Day 3 Wrap-up], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001120012500/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Format:''' various: World Championship [[Premiere - Endor]]; side events in [[Japanese Sealed Deck]], [[Progressive Sealed Deck]], [[Players' Choice Sealed Deck]], [[Iron Man]], [[No Such Thing As Luck]], [[The Gauntlet: Dual Formats]], [[Allegiances: Multi-Deck Format]], [[Enhanced Format Sealed Deck]], [[EPP Overdrive]], and [[Team Event Format]]

== Venue and dates ==

* '''Dates:''' 11–14 November 1999 (Thursday–Sunday)
* '''Site:''' Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia<ref name="dc99-home">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/ DecipherCon 1999], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020823212712/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/ Internet Archive]</ref>

Thursday 11 November held the Star Wars and Star Trek Wild Card Opens and the first side events.<ref name="dc99-thu">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Thursday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021005063305/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="lal-thu">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/thursday.html DecipherCon '99 — Day 1 Wrap-up], Francis K. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000708001407/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html Internet Archive]</ref> Saturday 13 November held Worlds Day 2 and the Final Confrontations.<ref name="dc99-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Saturday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026023004/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="lal-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html DecipherCon '99 — Day 3 Wrap-up], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001120012500/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html Internet Archive]</ref> Sunday 14 November held the team challenges and remaining side events.<ref name="dc99-sun">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Sunday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026063736/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Francis K. Lalumiere wrote that the convention store sold Austin Powers CCG starters, Young Jedi The Jedi Council, and a Fajo Collection sale on Thursday.<ref name="lal-thu">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/thursday.html DecipherCon '99 — Day 1 Wrap-up], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000903021929/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/thursday.html Internet Archive]</ref> Rules of Acquisition and Austin Powers boosters were expected Friday. Enhanced Cloud City and Japanese Star Wars CCG product were expected Saturday morning.<ref name="lal-thu">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/thursday.html DecipherCon '99 — Day 1 Wrap-up], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000903021929/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/thursday.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Guests ==

Special guests were Chase Masterson (Leeta), [[Shannon Baksa]] (Mara Jade), [[Aron Eisenberg]] (Nog), and [[Jeremy Bulloch]] (Boba Fett). Signings ran Friday 1–3 p.m. and Saturday and Sunday 12–2 p.m., free for convention participants.<ref name="guests">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests/index.html Special guests], DecipherCon 1999, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021005040225/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests/index.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="lal-fri">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/friday.html DecipherCon '99 — Day 2 Wrap-up], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001120001100/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/friday.html Internet Archive]</ref> Baksa appeared as Mara Jade in costume.<ref name="lal-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html DecipherCon '99 — Day 3 Wrap-up], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001120012500/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher staff on site included Warren Holland; artists Rob Burns and Joe Boulden; and product development staff [[Bill Martinson]], Sandy Wible, Tim Ellington, and [[Chuck Kallenbach]].<ref name="guests">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests/index.html Special guests], DecipherCon 1999, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021005040225/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests/index.html Internet Archive]</ref> A 1965 Corvette promoted the Austin Powers CCG.<ref name="guests">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests/index.html Special guests], DecipherCon 1999, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021005040225/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests/index.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Star Wars CCG World Championship ==

Full results, lists, decks, and the Final Confrontation are on [[1999 Decipher World Championship]]. The constructed pool was [[Premiere - Endor]]. The field of 32 was 4 Open + 2 Invitational + 23 Regional + 2 Wild Card + 1 defending champion ([[Matt Potter]]).<ref name="field">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/swworldchamp/finalists.html Finalists], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991128125001/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/swworldchamp/finalists.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Thursday's Wild Card Open (SW.01) put 147 players on Decipher's score sheet. The top two, [[John Arendt]] and [[James Lafferty]], took seats into Friday's field of 32.<ref name="dc99sw01_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW01_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: 1999 SW Wildcard], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20011101231420/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW01_1.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="lal-thu">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/thursday.html DecipherCon '99 — Day 1 Wrap-up], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000903021929/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/thursday.html Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Joe Alread]] won Iron Man on Friday and missed the main event.<ref name="lal-fri">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/friday.html DecipherCon '99 — Day 2 Wrap-up], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001120001100/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/friday.html Internet Archive]</ref> [[Kathy Lischke]] reported on Decipher's event board that his prize was a set of uncut Premiere sheets. Cards sent to the Lost Pile in that event went into a shredder.<ref name="kl-iron">[http://calder.decipher.com/cgi-bin/msgbd?dconerb$9521-11290$1 "Joe Alread: Ironman"], [[Kathy Lischke]], DecipherCon: Event Report Board, Decipher (12 November 1999). The archived copy is cut off mid-post. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001025060303/http://calder.decipher.com:80/cgi-bin/msgbd?dconerb$9521-11290$1 Internet Archive]</ref>

On Saturday morning, Lischke reported, [[Gary Carman]] found that his planned decks were missing. He built two new decks with help from another qualifier and took them into the final.<ref name="kl-necessity">[http://calder.decipher.com/cgi-bin/msgbd?dconerb$10751-27562$1 "Necessity is the mother of invention"], [[Kathy Lischke]], DecipherCon: Event Report Board, Decipher (13 November 1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001028020703/http://calder.decipher.com:80/cgi-bin/msgbd?dconerb$10751-27562$1 Internet Archive]</ref>

An ECC sealed event on Saturday drew 176 players. Lalumiere called it "the biggest tournament in Star Wars CCG history", ahead of the 152 at Origins constructed.<ref name="lal-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html DecipherCon '99 — Day 3 Wrap-up], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001120012500/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Star Wars CCG Team Championship ==

Sunday 14 November 1999 was the DecipherCon Team Challenge (SW.06), 10 a.m.–4 p.m.<ref name="dc99-sun">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Sunday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026063736/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html Internet Archive]</ref> A team of four won it: [[Martin Akesson]], [[Paul Todd Feldman]], [[Koen Meijssen]], and [[Yannick Lapointe]].<ref name="trando-iv7">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/iv7.htm Martin Akesson interview], [[Trandosite]] (31 August 2000). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041026204829/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/iv7.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="drazin">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/ErikDark.html Feldman's Drazin Deck: Decipher Con Team Play Winning Deck], Paul Todd Feldman, Torch Industries. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000303173004/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/ErikDark.html Internet Archive]</ref> Full coverage is on [[DecipherCon 1999 Team Event]].

== Other games ==

=== Star Trek CCG World Championship ===

DecipherCon 1999 hosted the Star Trek CCG World Championship. Mike Harrington won the title, defeating Dan Allman in the Final Confrontation.<ref name="lal-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html DecipherCon '99 — Day 3 Wrap-up], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001120012500/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html Internet Archive]</ref> Decipher's Radio Free Decipher audio feeds carried [[Evan Lorentz]]'s thoughts on round 1 of the finals.<ref name="lorentz-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/audiofeeds/SAT/index.html DecipherCon 1999 audio feeds: Saturday], Decipher (1999). Listing: "Evan's thoughts on Round 1 of ST finals (M. Tuttle, E. Lorentz) 0:50mins". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001101021759/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ02_2.html Internet Archive]</ref> Qualifier #3 constructed (YJ.03) listed 24 players; David Kelly finished first.<ref name="dc99yj03_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ03_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Qualifier #3 Constructed], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001101014900/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ03_1.html Internet Archive]</ref> Qualifier #4 sealed (YJ.04) listed 47 players; Rob Jones finished first.<ref name="dc99yj04_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ04_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Qualifier #4 Sealed], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001101031101/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ04_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Saturday Day 2 (YJ.05) listed 32 players. Greg Heisler led on 10 (116).<ref name="dc99yj05_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ05_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ World Championships Day 2], Decipher. === FASA and Austin Powers ===

FASA ran RPG slots plus Vor and Crimson Skies miniature demos.<ref name="dc99-thu">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Thursday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021005063305/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="lal-thu">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/thursday.html DecipherCon '99 — Day 1 Wrap-up], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000903021929/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/thursday.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="lal-fri">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/friday.html DecipherCon '99 — Day 2 Wrap-up], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001120001100/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/friday.html Internet Archive]</ref> Austin Powers CCG demos ran in the playing areas, and players bought a new booster shipment from the store on Friday.<ref name="lal-fri">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/friday.html DecipherCon '99 — Day 2 Wrap-up], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001120001100/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/friday.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Seminars and other program ==

The Star Wars schedule listed a Deck Building Clinic (SW.41) on Thursday 6–8 p.m. and a Product Development seminar (SW.42) on Friday 11 a.m.–1 p.m.<ref name="dc99-thu">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Thursday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021005063305/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99-fri">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Friday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000708001407/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html Internet Archive]</ref> Lalumiere wrote that Friday also held a seminar on the evolution of a Star Trek CCG card from concept to print.<ref name="lal-fri">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/friday.html DecipherCon '99 — Day 2 Wrap-up], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001120001100/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/friday.html Internet Archive]</ref> Celebrity signings ran Friday 1–3 p.m. and Saturday and Sunday 12–2 p.m.<ref name="guests">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests/index.html Special guests], DecipherCon 1999, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021005040225/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests/index.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher's convention home linked daily wrap-ups, a photo album, an event schedule with scores, special-guest pages, World Championship indexes, and related program pages.<ref name="dc99-home">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/ DecipherCon 1999], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020823212712/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/ Internet Archive]</ref>
